title: Lab - Commands and arguments
scenario: Override what a container runs. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Read
tasks.instructions: What command does Pod ubuntu-sleeper run?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Sleep longer
tasks.instructions: Create ubuntu-sleeper-2 from image ubuntu that sleeps 5000 seconds.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Args
tasks.instructions: Create Pod webapp-green from image kodekloud/webapp-color with argument --color=green.
